title: Astro Small Examples
description: Use these small Astro examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Make an Astro page
examples.description: An .astro page combines a frontmatter script with HTML-like markup.
examples.code:
--- const club = "Reading club"; ---

{club}

Pick a story today.
examples.output: The home page contains the club heading and paragraph as HTML.

examples.title: Make a second page
examples.description: Astro uses the pages folder to create routes.
examples.output: The /books route contains a simple book list.

examples.title: Use normal page links
examples.description: Astro pages can use ordinary HTML links.
examples.code: Book listAbout the club
examples.output: The links open the corresponding pages when those pages exist.

examples.title: Reuse a component with props
examples.description: An Astro component can read values from Astro.props.
examples.output: Import BookCard into a page and use <BookCard title="Moon Trip" /> to show the title.

examples.title: Wrap content with a layout
examples.description: A layout component can provide the outer page structure.
examples.output: A page that imports Base and wraps its content in <Base> gets the shared document structure.

examples.title: Make a list at build time
examples.description: A static data array can become HTML during the Astro build.
examples.output: The output HTML has one list item for each title.

examples.title: Keep component CSS nearby
examples.description: Styles in an Astro component are scoped by default.
examples.output: The article has a navy border and its heading is navy.

examples.title: Add a browser script
examples.description: A script tag can run client-side JavaScript on an Astro page.
examples.output: The button updates the paragraph in the browser.

examples.title: Use a real public asset
examples.description: The public folder holds files copied without processing.
examples.output: The browser loads the local badge and can reserve its dimensions.

examples.title: Build known dynamic routes
examples.description: A bracketed page can use a route value. For static output, getStaticPaths lists the pages Astro should create.
examples.output: The build creates two book pages with their own titles.

examples.title: Add one interactive island
examples.description: An island is a component that receives browser JavaScript only when a client directive asks for it.
examples.output: The React counter becomes interactive when its JavaScript loads. The heading stays ordinary static HTML.

examples.title: Build and inspect the output
examples.description: A static build produces HTML and assets that a static host can serve.
examples.code:
npm run build
npm run preview
examples.output: Astro builds the site to dist and starts a local preview using the project's preview command.
